title: Appeal Void Log [Tempbanned]

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Max,

Regardless of who involved, the offense messes with statistics, and it's already illegal to do it as per the rules page, no matter how it's depicted. The situation still deems it not permitted (just because one player is fine with it), and therefore I will have to decline this punishment's appeal. As well as this, you have been punished for logging before.

Please use this moment to re-read the rules at http://avicus.net/rules, and try just waiting out your ban.

Regards,
Kavinsky.
